subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 2/7] mountd: prime the kernel caches over netlink on MOUNT

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to prime the kernel caches over netlink when a MOUNT request is made, rather than writing directly to /proc channels. This ensures that export state carried only by netlink is not lost. The patch also updates the nl_add_ip_map function to include an expiry TTL and allows cross-mount submounts to be sent over netlink as well.
